summary: Stuart Edward Mann was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Bristol (ca. 1923–1927). He taught English at Masaryk University (ca. 1929–1939) and Czech and Albanian at the School of Slavonic and East European Studies (1947–1972).
Stuart H. Blackburn is an Indologist who studied at Wesleyan University and the University of California, Berkeley. He held an academic post at SOAS University of London from around 1994 to 2011.

Stuart Henry Buck was a scholar in Tibetology who studied at Harvard University, earning an A.B. around 1929–1933. He later worked as an intelligence analyst for the National Security Agency from roughly 1952 to 1980.

Stuart Piggott was an archaeologist and Indologist. Educated at Churcher's College, University College London, and the UCL Institute of Archaeology, he held posts at Reading Museum (1927), the University of Oxford (ca. 1943–1946), and the University of Edinburgh (Professor, 1948).

Stuart Ray Sarbacker is a scholar in religious studies, Indology, and philosophy. He earned his Ph.D. in 2001 from the University of Wisconsin-Madison, where he studied under doctoral supervisor David M. Knipe.

Su Bai (1922–2018) was a Chinese archaeologist, Buddhist studies scholar, and sinologist. He studied at Peking University under Chengjun Feng, Zuoyun Sun, Rong Geng, and Yongtong Tang, and served as a professor at Peking University from 1948 to 2004.

Subhadradis Diskul was a Thai archaeologist who studied at Chulalongkorn University, École du Louvre under Philippe Stern, and UCL/University of London. He served as professor, dean, and rector at Silpakorn University, and later directed SEAMEO SPAFA (1987–1992).
Subhash Chandra is a scholar in computational linguistics and Indology who earned his Ph.D. from Jawaharlal Nehru University (2007–2012). As of 2026, he is a professor at the University of Delhi.

Subhash Kak is an Indologist and engineer who earned his Ph.D. at IIT Delhi under Pavaguda V. Indiresan. He held professorships at Louisiana State University (from 1979) and Oklahoma State University (from 2007), among other visiting appointments.

Subodhkant Mishra is an Indology and religious studies scholar educated at Banaras Hindu University, Delhi University, and IGNOU. He held posts at Shree Mahendra Das Degree College (2023–2024), Indus University (2025), and Central University of Punjab (Assistant Professor, 2026).

Subrata K. Mitra studied at Utkal, Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, and Rochester universities. He served as Head of Political Science at Heidelberg University (1994–2014) and Director and Research Professor at the National University of Singapore (2015–2018).
Sucharita Adluri is a scholar of religious studies and Indology. She completed her Ph.D. at the University of Pennsylvania and was appointed professor at Cleveland State University in 2009.

Sucheng Chan is a historian who completed her studies at Swarthmore College, the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, and the University of California, Berkeley. She served as an emerita professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara (ca. 1988–2005).
Sudan Shakya is a scholar in the fields of Buddhist studies and Indology. He has served as a professor at Shuchiin University, with his tenure attested between 2013 and 2026.

Sudarshan Chakradhari is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology. He earned his Ph.D. at Banaras Hindu University (2013–2019) and became an assistant professor at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University in 2023.

Sudhir Kakar was a scholar of religious studies and Indology who studied at Gujarat, Mannheim, and Vienna universities, and the Sigmund-Freud-Institut. He taught at Harvard, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Delhi, and was a visiting professor at INSEAD (1994–2013).

Sudhākara Dvivedī was an Indologist who studied under Devakṛṣṇa. He served at Sanskrit College and Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, where he worked as librarian from 1883, professor from 1890, and head of the mathematics faculty from 1898 to 1905.

Sue Hamilton is a scholar in Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. She earned her D.Phil. at Oxford under Richard Gombrich and Alexis Sanderson, was affiliated with King's College London (2001–2003), and was UCL's Director and Professor of Prehistory (2014–2022).

Suehiro Tanemura was a Japanese scholar who studied at the University of Tokyo (ca. 1953–1957). He later held academic appointments at Tokyo Metropolitan University and Kokugakuin University (ca. 1978–1998).

Sujeet Kumar is a scholar working in the fields of computational studies and Indology. He has held academic posts at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur and B.P. Mandal College of Engineering.
